chunks: What al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated from his brother al-Ḥasan, from Zurʿah, from Samāʿah, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
If janabah befalls a man and he puts his hand into the vessel, there is no harm, provided that nothing of the semen has reached his hand.

key_terms.الْمَنِيِّ: semen, whose presence on the hand affects the ruling
key_terms.جَنَابَةٌ: the state of major ritual impurity
key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: there is no problem or objection
key_terms.يَدَهُ: his hand, the limb whose contact with the vessel is under discussion

ai.seo_question: Does a person in janabah make vessel water problematic by placing his hand in it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning ritual purity in the state of janabah. It indicates that inserting the hand into a water vessel is not problematic so long as the hand has not been contaminated by semen.
